calculation.description: Ranks cross-asset 10-day reversal normalized by trailing 20-day realized volatility, conditioned by the trailing 10-day close location within the daily high-low range. Assets closing nearer lows receive a stronger reversal multiplier, while assets closing nearer highs receive attenuation. All inputs are causal at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: The early 2023-11 through 2025 regime was negative (-0.086788 over 104 dates), while subsequent regimes were consistently positive: 2026-2028 +0.050345 (634 dates), 2029-2031 +0.070342 (783 dates), and 2032-2035-08-01 +0.049998 (925 dates). Small cross-asset universe requires conservative interpretation; 15 assets were available and each IC date required at least 8 valid instruments.
